$purpose: Design handover for Hannah Lynn Mell's landing site, so OmniReality (and anyone building it, including Claude) can match its look, motion and voice. Values are taken from assets/css/styles.css and assets/js/*.js. When this file and the code disagree, the code wins.

client.name: Hannah Lynn Mell
client.practice_note: She makes soul collage: layers of meaning pasted over each other. The visual system borrows that: torn paper, overlapping scraps, windows cut into the grid.

concept.name: Confluence
concept.summary: Five colour currents (her palette) meet in one gradient. Bold colour lives in the wallpaper, her name and a few accents; everything else is a quiet, writerly page on graph (or lined) paper, with rips in the paper that open onto other scenes.
principles: One loud thing per view; the rest stays quiet and typographic.
The gradient is identical in light and dark modes; only grounds and inks swap.
Paper is the metaphor: grid or lined sheets, torn edges, collage scraps, hairline rules.
Depth through parallax: far things are slow and blurred, near things are fast and sharp.
Motion is light and optional: every animation has a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.

spark.role: highlight (lime), used sparingly: live dots, today ring, selection, focus in dark, the ⟐ core

confluence.use: Her name (background-clip text, 240% size, each line offset 0/50/100%), drop cap, Muse title, button underline/hover fill, avatar ring, nav underline, progress bars, gradient borders on panels and chat, the ⟐ mark stroke.

gradients.gradient_border_recipe: background: linear-gradient(<surface>, <surface>) padding-box, <confluence> border-box; border: 1px solid transparent;
gradients.highlight_card: radial-gradient(circle at 84% 16%, rgba(148,231,24,.9) 0 6%, transparent 6.5%), radial-gradient(90% 70% at 100% 100%, rgba(32,73,223,.85), transparent 70%), <confluence>
gradients.flyer: radial-gradient(circle at 82% 16%, #94E718 0 7%, transparent 7.5%), radial-gradient(110% 70% at 0% 100%, <pillar>, transparent 62%), radial-gradient(80% 60% at 100% 60%, rgba(244,50,11,.55), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(160deg, #1B1530, #2A1450 60%, #1B1530)

color.neutrals_note: Neutrals are violet-biased (never pure grey), pulled toward the palette.

display.use: Name, headings, card titles, big numerals. Italic for voice moments.

utility.use: Labels, eyebrows, chips, counters, meta. 0.75rem, uppercase, letter-spacing .08em.

symbol.stack: 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Apple Symbols', 'Noto Sans Symbols 2', 'Noto Sans Math', 'DejaVu Sans'
symbol.use: The ⟐ glyph in labels/nav. Large ⟐ marks are drawn as SVG.

hero_name.notes: Three stacked lines (Hannah / Lynn / Mell); line 2 italic 400 indented 0.9em, line 3 indented 0.32em; gradient text.

details: Drop cap on the first About paragraph: display face, 4.6em, gradient-filled.
Headings use text-wrap: balance; prose uses text-wrap: pretty and hanging punctuation.
Big numerals (calendar next-up, flyer date) are display face with the confluence gradient.
Colophon in the footer names the typefaces (she loves typography).

sections.grid: 150px label column + 1fr body; one column under 820px
sections.label: mono uppercase, sticky at top: 24px

layout.dividers: Between sections: a five-line music staff (17px tall, 1px lines every 4px, faded at the ends).
layout.margins: Outside the frame the wallpaper shows; the seasonal symbols fall there.

radii.arch: 999px 999px 3px 3px (hero portrait and every other carousel photo)

lined.margin_rule: 1px rgba(244,50,11,.35) with a 3px echo at rgba(244,50,11,.18), inside the frame's left padding

header.content: Avatar (40px, 2px confluence ring, 2px ground inner border) + 'HLM' mono 0.3em tracking; italic nav links with a gradient underline that grows on hover; light/dark toggle (56×30 pill, gradient knob with sun/moon).
header.sticky: Sticks to the top; once scrolled >24px it tightens (padding 12px), turns to ground at 55% with the same grid pinned to the viewport (background-attachment: fixed, synced to the grid parallax), blur 10px, and fades out at the bottom via mask-image (#000 72% → transparent).

order: location eyebrow with lime live dot
name + tagline + roles + actions | arched portrait
hero.roles_list: mono labels, each with a 12×2px dash in its pillar colour

buttons.primary: mono uppercase 0.78rem, ink bg, 14×22 padding, 2px radius; a 3px confluence bar at the bottom that fills the whole button on hover (text turns white)
buttons.text_link: italic body text with a 1px confluence underline (2px on hover)
buttons.round_icon: 42px circle, 1px hair-strong border, fills ink on hover

components.chips: mono 0.62rem uppercase, 1px currentColor border, 999px radius; 'ghost' variant is dashed at 70% opacity (used for Sample / Coming soon).

carousel.autoplay: 6s, pauses on hover, focus, open drawer, hidden tab, or 12s after any interaction

components.highlight_card: Confluence card with a lime dot, a translucent torn-paper strip across the middle (collage), chips at the top, italic display title, date/time footer with 'Details ↓'.
components.calendar_card: Paper card with a 16px grid texture, month label, mini month of dots (event days in pillar colour, today ringed in lime), a big gradient numeral for the next date, 'Open ↓'.

drawer.behavior: Opens under the carousel with grid-template-rows 0fr → 1fr (.55s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)); contents fade/slide in. Escape, Close or re-clicking the card closes it.
drawer.highlight_panel: left: flier (4:5, rotated -1.5deg, deep shadow; typographic fallback built from data); right: kicker, title, italic subtitle, facts table (When / Where / Format / Cost / Space with mono labels), description, CTA + text link
drawer.calendar_panel: left: legend (dashed box, colour swatches + Today ring) → month header with arrows → 7-column day grid (days are buttons with dots, today ring, selected = inverted, highlight day = gradient border, past days 50%) → selected-day state; right: 'Coming up' agenda of 6 with big numerals and a pillar-colour bar

rips.construction: A torn outline: 120-point polygon with low-frequency harmonics (sin 2a, 3a, 5a) for an organic shape, alternating 2.5–6% inward 'fibre' notches, ends pinched like a tear. An outer copy 9px larger in rip_paper colour with the grid printed on it forms the torn paper edge. Soft drop shadow, slight rotation (-9..9deg).
rips.placement: Only in the gaps between sections (on the staff dividers), never under text.

scenes.sky: day: blue gradient (#4F86EC → #8DBBFA → #E6F1FF), warm sun glow, drifting clouds; night: stars + nebula
scenes.mountain: two ridges (back #9DB2D6, front #5F7FA8) with snowcaps, lake with mirrored reflection and shimmer; night: violet ridges, moon
scenes.beach: sea (#1F7CC4 → #4CB5E6), moving foam line, sand (#F3DDB0 → #E4C088), a beach ball; night: moonlit
scenes.tree: a whole branching tree on a green hill; foliage follows the current season (spring blossoms, summer greens, fall reds/oranges, winter bare with snow); night: silhouette under stars
scenes.stars: night only, even in light mode: deep sky (#070519 → #140C38 → #2A1A55), nebula in her colours, twinkling stars with sparkle crosses on the brightest, a shooting star every 5–12s

rips.collage_layers: Smaller torn scraps pasted over a rip's corner, each showing a different scene (e.g. sky over mountain, tree over beach).
rips.parallax: rip moves -0.03 × offset from viewport centre; the scene inside moves more (0.1), clamped, so it reads as a window.

omni_loader.section: ⟐ OmniReality, between the hero and About
omni_loader.stage: grid/lined paper band (clamp 420–560px tall), edges faded, with a large 'stars' rip in the middle
omni_loader.mark: SVG diamond (outer 5px confluence stroke, inner 1.2px at 55%) with a lime centre dot; glow drop-shadow(0 0 18px rgba(141,29,226,.8)); rotates 0→180deg and scales .7→1 with progress; pulses when ready
omni_loader.motion: Tokens start scattered and spiral into three elliptical orbits (radii 1 / .87 / .75 of min(44% width, 380px) × min(42% height, 200px); speeds .22/.16/.11, middle ring counter-rotates). Progress is scroll-linked (0 when the stage enters, 1 at viewport centre) with easeInOutCubic. Front of the orbit is larger. Status reads 'Condensing · N%' then 'Ready'.
omni_loader.match_in_omnireality: OmniReality's own load screen should reuse this: same mark, same token set, same orbit geometry, stars background.

seasonal_margins.where: Falling in the side margins outside the frame (full width at low alpha when margins are narrow); plus a light flurry of ~10 across the page as each section scrolls into view

sets.spring: five-petal flowers, daisies, cherry blossoms, tulips
sets.summer: beach balls and striped beach chairs
sets.winter: six-armed snowflakes with a white core and a blue/violet outline

seasonal_margins.motion: 14–34px/s fall, sine sway 8–30px, slow spin, leaves flip (scaleX cos). Size 16–32px. Opacity .55–.9.
seasonal_margins.breeze: The pointer pushes pieces away (radius 130px) and along its path; drag settles them back. Fast pointer moves leave faint curved wind streaks; a tap on touch sends an expanding gust ring (520px/s) with radial streaks. The floating 3D shapes lean away from the pointer by up to 60px × depth.
seasonal_margins.auto_season: by month, northern hemisphere; switcher in the footer

types.sphere: layered radial gradients with a specular highlight and inset shadow
types.cube: CSS 3D six faces, translucent gradient glass, 1px white edges
types.torus: conic gradient ring masked to an annulus, tilted rotateX(64deg)

shapes_3d.depth: 0.1 (far: big, blurred up to 2px+, slow) to 0.9 (near: sharp, fast); scale .55 + depth×.9; they loop vertically and rotate with scroll

components.spotify_dock: Bottom-right pill 'Listen' with a lime equaliser; opens a gradient-bordered panel with the Spotify embed; one iframe that never moves so playback survives scrolling.
components.chat: Bottom-left pill with her avatar 'Chat with Hannah'. Panel 370×540 max, gradient border, grid-textured log, Hannah's bubbles on ground with hairline border (4px corner at the tail), visitor bubbles inverted; mono chip buttons; round gradient send button. Standalone site only.
components.footer: Margins season switcher, Paper switcher, colophon in italic, © line.
components.scrollbar: 6px, transparent track; idle thumb rgba(110,100,140,.18); while scrolling the thumb turns into the confluence gradient, fading back 900ms after scrolling stops.

motion.reduced_motion: No drift, no falling, no orbit spin, no autoplay; the loader shows its finished state; parallax off.

voice_and_copy.tone: Warm, grounded, plainspoken, a little playful; first person when it's Hannah speaking.
voice_and_copy.casing: Headings in sentence case; Substack titles keep her lowercase style.
sample_lines: Where music, movement, spirit and the page run together.
Everything here, gathered into one point.
voice_and_copy.chat_persona: Speaks as Hannah, labelled 'Automatic replies · your messages reach me directly'. Crisis language always gets 988 / 911 resources.

accessibility: Visible focus ring: 2px solid focus colour, 3px offset.
Pillar colours have separate text-safe variants per theme (text_on_ground).
Decorative layers are aria-hidden; the calendar days and cards are real buttons with labels; Escape closes panels and chat.

assets.photos: assets/img: avatar.jpg, hero.jpg, about.jpg, slide-1..3.jpg (from HLM01–HLM05); placeholders for slide-4..6, music/movement/healing/writing, highlight-flyer.
